_comment: Which paths must never be published, as data.
The owner's instruction (2026-11-26): the working papers -- the gap ledger and the plan -- cannot become
public by any route, while the rest of the execution subset is tracked normally. `procdocs_gate.py`
enforces that from the index side and this list is the only place the set is written down.
为什么是数据而不是写在门禁里：这份集合会变（新的过程文档会出现），而「哪些东西不能公开」是业主的决定，
不该埋在代码的判断里。改这里等于改一条安全属性，所以门禁对每一条都要求 .gitignore 里也有对应规则——
两个独立的锁，缺一个就红。
Patterns use a simple intent: `dir/**` protects the directory and everything below it;
`prefix/*.md` protects the matches directly in `prefix`; anything else is a plain glob.
Do NOT use `workspace/**`: that would protect the code, which is the opposite of the point.
why: process notes: self-criticism, internal sequencing, owner instructions. Kept locally, never shipped.
why_markdown: Documents whose whole value is being readable: a table that renders as bare `|` text is not a ledger.
The gap ledger grew by appending single rows separated by blank lines; a Markdown table ends at the first blank
line, so most of it rendered as prose (owner: "preview 不出来", 2026-11-26). P4/P5 keep it that way.
